answer: An agent economy resists sybils with a trellis of earned rungs: each agent starts at the ground, and every rung upward demands a fresh cipher proof of real work, sealed to a relic, a record of past honest deeds no new identity can borrow. A stranger checks each proof and keeps no tie to the climber. A relic with no rungs earns no vote, and a failed cipher check drops the climber to the ground. Faking 100 voters needs 2,500 trellis rungs, 2,500 cipher proofs, and 5,000 POA at risk. Like a trellis holding only vines that truly grew, a vote counts only after work no shortcut can fake.
